about.title: About VVIP
about.intro: Viro Ke Vir Indian Party (VVIP) is a registered political party in India, officially registered on 14 February 2023.
foundingBody: The party emerged from founder Laljibhai Bodar's experience supporting an independent candidate in the 2019 Lok Sabha elections in Varanasi. When that candidacy was rejected, Bodar felt compelled to build a political alternative from the ground up.
That conviction grew into a mission: to identify well-educated, non-corrupt and dedicated individuals across India who could serve in Parliament — not for power, but for the people.
about.nameBody: ‘Viro Ke Vir’ translates to ‘heroes of heroes’, reflecting our vision of India as the land of heroes, sages and agriculture — a nation whose heritage deserves representatives worthy of it.
about.missionBody: We aim to build a parliament composed of well-educated, honest, devoted and dedicated individuals serving the nation. Drawing on Chanakya Niti, we believe educated and cultured citizens deserve respect — and that India's heroic heritage positions it to lead the world.
about.mottoBody: “Truth is troubled but cannot be defeated.”

ideology.title: Our Ideology
ideology.intro: Nation First — our foundational principle, emphasizing India's integrity, unity and cultural heritage above all else.

pillars.title: Nationalism & National Integration
pillars.body: We view India as an eternal nation of agriculture and sages, united by culture rather than geography alone. We celebrate India's diversity as a defining strength, not a divide.

pillars.title: Democracy
pillars.body: Drawing from Rigvedic principles — ‘truth is one, but scholars express it in different ways’ — we support pluralistic democratic values and inclusivity across every caste and community.

pillars.title: Ethics & Justice
pillars.body: We commit to fighting injustice, exploitation and corruption, while setting new standards of accountability for collective welfare and societal well-being.

pillars.title: Universal Justice
pillars.body: Inspired by Gandhian philosophy, we prioritize universal access to food, clothing, housing, education, employment and healthcare. Our vision is justice for all, without exception.

pillars.title: Values-Based Politics
pillars.body: Ethics, loyalty, fearlessness, humility and faith guide us. We seek to restore moral values to public life and governance, one representative at a time.

ideology.slogan1Sub: Honouring soldiers and farmers as India's protectors and providers
ideology.slogan2Sub: A patriotic expression of devotion to Mother India

constitution.title: Party Constitution
constitution.intro: As amended by the National Council, February 2022.
constitution.nameBody: The organisation is called ‘Viro Ke Vir Indian Party’, abbreviated as VVIP.
objectivePoints: Building a modern, progressive and enlightened India that honours its ancient cultural heritage while establishing itself as an influential global power.
Establishing democratic governance rooted in political, social and economic justice, with equal opportunity across every demographic.
Ensuring freedom of religious belief and expression without discrimination of caste, creed, religion or gender.
Prioritising educated, nationally-dedicated candidates for public representation.
Maintaining true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of India, and upholding socialism, secularism and democracy.
constitution.downloadBody: The complete constitution is available at our office on request.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Viro Ke Vir Indian Party collects and uses the information you share with us.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you submit a form on this site — to join, volunteer, donate or contact us — we collect the information you provide, such as your name, phone number, email address and message.

sections.title: How We Use It
sections.body: We use this information solely to coordinate party activities, respond to your enquiries, and communicate with you about membership, volunteering or events. We do not sell your information to third parties.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or wish to have your information removed, contact us using the details on our Contact page.
